notes.title: Dev Diary - Multiplayer & UI revamp 🤼 ✨
notes.content:
Hello, amazing adventurer, 👋

I'm reaching out with a mix of excitement and gratitude. It's been a while since our last update, and I sincerely apologize for the delay. 🙇‍♂️ Life has a funny way of getting in the middle of things, especially when you're juggling a full-time job and the passion project that is Guilds n Glory. My time management skills clearly need some work! 🫣

But let's not dwell on the past; instead, I want to share the progress we've made and where we're headed. 

[h3]🎮 Multiplayer Magic! 🎮[/h3]

We've taken a giant leap into the multiplayer realm, and it's been an exhilarating journey. Guilds n Glory will support up to 4-player split-screen action! Here's a sneak peek.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723385/8b8824770a128b0337b3bc227577bb5b0c5773e9.gif[/img]

[h3]🔊 Sound Spatialization Story 🔊[/h3]

Crafting an immersive audio experience for 4-player split-screen setup is a challenge we've gladly embraced. We're working hard to make sure every sound comes from the right direction while maintaining the illusion of depth. I'll soon share a technical article explaining our approach because transparency is key.

[h3]🎨 Revamping Look & Feel 🎨[/h3]

We've given the game's user experience and interface a complete makeover. Out with the old, in with the new and intuitive. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723385/e0b95aae5d17b623dc588c3c72d9c6cd3ffe2a0d.gif[/img]

[h3]🏹 Tactical Flocking 🏹[/h3]

Strategy takes centre stage as army units can now form tactical formations such as flank, circle, triangle, and more. Timing and strategy become your best friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723385/41e4c7e9c3488bf24a3b4f49c836d6759aa2b294.gif[/img]

[h3]📣 Social Media Adventures 📣[/h3]

I've ventured into the world of social media marketing 📣, and it's been both fun and time-consuming. Your support on social media is invaluable, and I promise to keep experimenting until we get it just right.

Aaaand I want to take a moment to thank you from the bottom of my heart 🙏. Your unwavering support means the world, especially for a small indie developer like me. Here's why your support matters:

[list]
[*] Motivation: Your enthusiasm keeps me going, even on the toughest days. 💪
[*] Feedback: Your insights are like gold, helping shape Guilds n Glory into something truly special. 💡
[*] Community: Our Guilds n Glory community is a treasure, and I'm grateful to have you all on this journey with me. 🫂
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue this incredible adventure together. Let's keep the indie spirit alive and make Guilds n Glory a game to remember.

With gratitude,
Guilds n Glory (super tiny) team

P.S. 💌 Stay even closer to the Guilds n Glory action! Join[url=https://www.guildsnglory.com/#subscribe] our newsletter[/url] for exclusive updates and personal tidbits. Your support means the world to us! 😊
